name: select
changelog: `helper` and `error` under the trigger (the error rings the trigger in `danger` and is announced), `required` (visible label asterisk, announced), `variant` (`secondary` on a surface); `FlSelectOption.leading` (icon, flag, avatar) before the label in the list and, once chosen, in the trigger. New optional parameters, nothing breaks.
title: Select
description: Offers one or several choices from a closed list, from a trigger that shows the current choice. A list as wide as the trigger, or a bottom sheet or a dialog.
